services.name: Our Yachts
services.desc: The Spirit of Tahoe joined our fleet in June of 2021. Originally from Miami, she was renovated for daily cruises on Lake Tahoe. Offering guests ample indoor and outdoor seating for daily cruises to Emerald Bay and Sunset champagne cruise every evening. services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Private yacht charters on Lake Tahoe can feel like they’re out of reach. The Safari Rose changes that. With rates starting at $2,500, you get the full private experience - the largest yacht on the lake, your own crew, and a bartender - without the price tag you might expect. For a group of 15, that’s around $267 per person for a few hours on the most iconic lake in the country. The Safari Rose offers an elegant setting for up to 68 guests, accompanied by a professional crew of 3-4. While she can host a full capacity event, many groups prefer a smaller gathering-around 35 guests in the cooler months-to ensure everyone can relax comfortably inside.
